Q FEATURES
Area Exterior Area Accessories
Q1 Tyres Standard Tyres to have a Single ‘Arrow’ Painted to Each Wheel Q22 Race Suits 1959 Blue Race Suits, with Logo (Left Chest) and Wings (Right Chest) Embroidery

Q23 Race Gloves Replica of Carroll Shelby’s Gloves (2 Pairs Per Car)

Q10 Personalised Sill Plaques Containing Side Profile of Winning DBR1 and Stating ‘Built to Commemorate 60th Q28 Bespoke Handbook Cover Finished in Chestnut Tan & Featuring the DBS 59 Logo (1 Per Car)
Anniversary of the DBR1 Victory at Le Mans’ - Sill Plaques to be Anodised Black Q29 Bespoke Build Book Finished in Chestnut Tan (1 Per Car)
Q11 Wings Badges Union Flag Wings Badge - HM Stirling Silver (waiver required) Q30 Bespoke Key Pouch Finished in Chestnut Tan (1 Per Car)
Area Interior
Q12 Bespoke Rear Environment Bespoke Saddle Leather Helmet Pods, with Housing for Race Suits and Gloves
Q13 Bespoke Seat Backs and Seat material inspired by the DBR1, trimmed to the seat backs and door inserts
Door Inserts
Q14 Bespoke Trim Inlays Painted Aston Martin Racing Green
(door & fascia)
Q15 Headrest Embroidery Bespoke 'DBS 59' Logo in Ivory Tread
Q16 Headlining Bespoke headlining
Q17 Passenger Airbag Cover ‘60th Anniversary’ Embroidered on the Passenger-side Airbag Cover - Ivory Stitch
Q18 Bespoke B&O Cover Bespoke Embroidery
Q19 Paddle Shifters Painted Bronze to Match the Bronze Colour on the Switches of the DBR1
Q20 Engine Plaque Final Inspection Plaque - Bespoke Logo and Numbered (1 of 24)
Q21 Sun Visor Embroidery Bespoke Sun Visor Embroidery
